review_scope: Independent of material implementation: personally inspected all five final rendered views against previously personally inspected source images. Documentation was authored by this reviewer; this is not an independent documentation-authorship review. Full geometry/region and clean-build tests are separately performed by the parent.

views.front: Supported pale grey-white front and grey-taupe shading frames; grey stairs retain historical appearance, with no later red-orange artwork or new text.
views.rear: Unknown rear and oblique side faces remain neutral; no mirrored source coloring.
views.elevation: True recessed window backings are grey-green, entry backing is dark, and entrance voids remain open.
views.source-angle: Supported front/right material families consistent with historical image; left low canopy grey is supported. No visible fragmented color patches.
views.top: Broad roof, core, base and unknown surfaces remain neutral; no invented equipment or cropped overall geometry.

limitations: Partial source-supported material approximation, not a current-condition survey or a single-date appearance reconstruction.
School-history photograph spans two pages; those pages are not independent viewpoints. PDF metadata and completion date are not photograph dates.
Later official entrance image has red-orange stair artwork lacking original geometry boundaries; it is deliberately omitted and original grey stairs retained.
Continuous original window strips are opaque appearance proxies, not certified glazing or transparency.
Unknown oblique/back/roof surfaces remain neutral. No new geometry, inscription or equipment.
Original 0.0502% thin-feature warning remains. Print QA was not rerun and no trial print is claimed.
